title: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
authors: Chi Zhang, Penglin Cai et al

tldr.zh:
**核心：**TTP 在 VLA 中结合视觉语言理解、动作生成和触觉预测专家，联合学习未来动作与触觉，并通过统一人机动作／触觉表示，实现人类示范预训练到机器人微调的迁移。
**结构与输入：**基于 BeingH-0.5 增加触觉输入及触觉预测专家；图像、指令、本体状态与历史触觉作为条件，用流匹配联合训练动作和触觉预测。MPG 门控调节两个专家所用的上下文特征。
**数据边界：**H-Tac 包含几何推算接触、触觉手套实测及仿真信号，不能将全部触觉监督理解为实测压力。
tldr.en:
**Core:** TTP combines vision-language understanding, action generation and tactile prediction experts in a VLA, jointly learning future actions and touch. Unified human/robot action and tactile representations support human-demonstration pretraining followed by robot fine-tuning.
**Structure/inputs:** Extend BeingH-0.5 with tactile inputs and a tactile prediction expert. Images, instructions, proprioception and tactile history condition joint flow-matching training; MPG gates context features used by both prediction experts.
**Data boundary:** H-Tac mixes geometry-derived contact, tactile-glove measurements and simulated signals; not all supervision is measured pressure.

evaluation_scope.zh: 9 项真机任务，Franka／Realman 搭配 Inspire、DexBotic 灵巧手或 DM-Tac 夹爪，包含单臂和双臂。需下游机器人微调，不是零样本人机迁移。削皮、折纸和其余任务分别采用长度、折叠进度和成功率，不能将汇总进度全部写成成功率；LIBERO 等无原生触觉的仿真使用状态与前次动作之差作触觉代理。
evaluation_scope.en: Nine real-robot tasks on Franka/Realman with Inspire or DexBotic hands or a DM-Tac gripper, in single/bimanual setups. Requires robot fine-tuning. Peeling length, folding progress and success rates are distinct metrics. Simulation benchmarks without native touch use state-minus-previous-action as a tactile proxy.
